best_idea: Model a block as a one-way edge stored on the blocker's side, make every DM and friend gate read it, untrack an open DM the moment a block lands, and answer unknown and blocked targets with the same error.
decision_why: Friends and blocking need this shape; the donor's DM gate is one-directional and does not gate party, guild or zone chat, so the gate must check both directions and cover every shared channel.
acceptance: A server test: after A blocks B, B's DM join with A and B's friend add of A both fail with the same text as an unknown id, A and B are untracked from their open DM in the same request, and A's own DM join with B is also refused.
